companies.name: Neuren Pharmaceuticals
companies.tagline: DAYBUE royalties fund the NNZ-2591 rare neurodevelopmental pipeline
facts: Q3 2026 DAYBUE net sales US$140m (+39% y/y); 2026 trofinetide income guided US$91–93m incl. the US$35m EU milestone (5 Nov 2026).
Japan Phase 3 trofinetide results consistent with LAVENDER; Japan NDA planned 2027.
FDA Orphan Drug Designation for NNZ-2591 in HIE (2 Nov 2026). Trofinetide US patents extended to Mar 2041.
Koala Phase 3 (Phelan-McDermid, ~160 children, placebo-controlled) dosing since Feb 2026; top-line timing not yet guided.
Broker targets: Ord Minnett A$27.80 (6 Nov 2026), Canaccord A$24.76 (1 Sep 2026).

scenarios.name: Bull

companies.name: Dimerix
companies.tagline: DMX-200 for the rare kidney disease FSGS, partnered in the US with Amicus
facts: ACTION3 Phase 3: 333 adults dosed across 219 sites in 21 countries; >90% power confirmed in blinded review (Apr 2026).
Shares fell ~36% on 28 Apr 2026 when the early (accelerated approval) readout was dropped; trial runs to final proteinuria endpoint.
Kidney Week (Oct 2026) human data link CCR2 activity to worse FSGS outcomes — supports the target, not proof DMX-200 works.
Up to A$34m non-dilutive facility (half drawn by Sep 2026). Bought DMX-652 (AKI) Jul 2026.
Partners: Amicus (US, up to US$560m milestones), Everest (Greater China/SE Asia), FUSO (Japan) and others.

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.note: ACTION3 misses in 2028; cash-strapped, shares collapse.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.note: Success, FDA approval ~2030, Amicus milestones and royalties flow.

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.note: Strong data plus buyout. Rare — don't anchor on it.

trials.note: Adults fully dosed (333, final adult started Mar 2026). Interim (2024) passed; CCR2 class has a poor record; no early readout (Apr 2026).

companies.name: LTR Pharma
companies.tagline: SPONTAN rapid-onset nasal vardenafil for erectile dysfunction; ROXUS for US compounding
facts: SPONTAN Phase II PK (May 2026): median Tmax 10 min vs 60 min for oral vardenafil; supports a 505(b)(2) US filing. Final results were guided for Q3 CY2026 — check they were released.
ROXUS: US exclusive pharmacy partner (Jun 2026) under the 503A compounding route for earlier US sales.
147-patient real-world study (Aug 2026): 68% overall reported improvement.
Cash ~A$24m (early 2026); market cap ~A$78m at A$0.43 (Oct 2026). Partners: Aptar (device), Mayne Pharma (manufacturing).
